title: [Feature Request] Lock/Hide OpenAPS SMB in config builder until Obj 9 has been completed
symptom: New users can select OpenAPS SMB in config builder from the beginning, even though SMBs are not yet possible, causing the algorithm to shut off basal during meal bolus window and guaranteeing post meal highs.
cause: The thread does not establish a root cause; it is a feature request to prevent selection of OpenAPS SMB until objective 9 is completed.
fix: The thread suggests that OpenAPS SMB should not be selectable until Obj 9 is completed, and OpenAPS AMA should be defaulted from the beginning. However, no resolution was implemented in the thread.
evidence_quote: In my opinion, it should NOT be possible to select OpenAPS SMB in config builder until Obj 9 has been completed.
